requirements: R1: Synchronize internal task 'done' status with actual GitHub PR unmerged states to resolve systemic discrepancies

slices.title: Fix GitHub PR status synchronization to prevent false 'done' states
slices.jtbd: When implementing status synchronization for this epic, I want to patch the internal task state updates based on actual GitHub PR states, so that tasks are never marked as done if their PR was closed without merging.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a task with an internal status of 'done' and an associated GitHub PR
When the system checks the PR state and finds it closed but not merged
Then the internal task status must not be 'done' and must be reverted to reflect the unmerged PR state
And the code change includes tests to verify this synchronization logic
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce false positive internal 'done' statuses for unmerged PRs to 0
